name: Horizon
description: Physically-based atmospheric sunset/sunrise simulator. Nishita single-scattering with ozone (Chappuis band), full spectral integration to a WebGL2 radiance LUT. Three physical controls — sun elevation, turbidity, altitude — drive a full-bleed dithered gradient. Exports adaptive-stop CSS/SVG gradients, PNG and 16-bit TIFF up to 8K, and permalinks.
